title: Built a One Piece TCG Mobile Browser game
author: OkSchool8369
selftext:
I've been building Grand Line TCG, a free, fan-made way to play the One Piece Card Game on your phone or PC, mostly with Claude Code.

A TypeScript rules engine that compiles the printed text of about 2,800 cards into a small effect language  
A CPU at four levels that plays offline  
Online matches and friend rooms on Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects  
A story mode with bosses and puzzles, pack opening and trophies

An installable web app, no download

Play: https://optcg.cc 

It's unofficial and non-commercial, with no ads and nothing to buy. Card names, text and images belong to Bandai.
